_readme: What the locked gate says. A refusal that only refuses is a dead end; this one names what
it wants and who would know where it is, so a player who walks east first - which is the
most natural opening move, the gate being four tiles from the spawn - leaves with a lead.

locked.text: Barred, and heavier than it looks. The keyhole wants a key you are not carrying - and the warden is the one who barred it.
